guide.title: Varian's Overview
guide.text:
Varian is a Bruiser who can also be played as
Melee Assassin or a Tank
depending on his Heroic Ability that can be picked at Level 4 rather
than Level 10 like other Heroes.

guide.title: Varian's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Role flexibility: Tank, Bruiser, Melee Assassin
Strong engage when played as Tank with Taunt
High burst damage when played as Melee Assassin with Colossus Smash
Good duelist when played as Offlaner with Twin Blades of Fury
Weaknesses
Limited mobility
Low waveclear
Weak before Level 4

guide.title: Varian's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Varian synergizes with
Taunt Build synergizes with Heroes who can easily follow up with
crowd control (like Malfurion that can
easily land a Root just a moment before the
Taunt is going to expire) and
burst damage (such as Jaina who will be able to
get full damage from her Blizzard).
Colossus Smash Build works better when your team has
crowd control but lacks
burst damage to follow up.
Twin Blades Build likes anything which can help Varian to stick on his target,
usually something provided by the Tank
(for example Johanna that can Slow and
Stun enemy Heroes nearby).
Varian is countered by
Varian, independently from the Build used, is countered by Heroes
who are able to kite him due to their range (such as Hanzo
who can also use Sonic Arrow to deny a flank)
and/or Heroes that have tools to drastically compromise his already low
mobility (such as Garrosh).
Taunt Build is countered by Heroes who have a tool to remove his
Taunt on a short cooldown (such as Rehgar
using Purge),
to mitigate the burst damage that will come
from his team (like Uther because he provides Armor
to allied Heroes via Devotion), or to completely deny it.
Colossus Smash Build is countered by Heroes that have something to reduce or nullify
the burst damage that will come from him and his teammates
(for example Medivh
because Force of Will provides Protected,
a status effect that has no direct counters).
Twin Blades Build heavily suffers from Heroes that can reduce his Attack Speed,
crowd control him, and/or burst
him down. Blinds are good against him as well.

guide.text:
Varian's stronger maps

Varian's weaker maps
Varian is good on Maps where team fights happen not only at the Objective but
also in other locations of the battlefield because he can gain advantage from the fact that his
Heroic Abilities have a really short cooldown and weak on Maps where there is
only one big team fight at the Objective because the enemy team can play safe
the rest of the time.

guide.title: Varian's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
When playing Taunt Build, remember that Taunt can be used to interrupt enemy channels (for example to stop Carrion Swarm by Mal'Ganis).
When going for Colossus Smash Build, always make sure to use Colossus Smash first and other Abilities after in order to increase all damage dealt thanks to the Armor reduction on the enemy Hero.
When choosing Twin Blades, do not go too far from your team so that they can focus the same enemy Hero as you and/or help you to survive.
If your team desperately needs a Tank, do not insist on taking Colossus Smash or Twin Blades of Fury at Level 4 because a Tank is really important to have in team.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Varian's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Varian can be played as:
Tank when going for Taunt Build;
Melee Assassin when going for Colossus Smash Build;
Offlaner when going for Twin Blades Build.
While it is quite useful to draft a flexible Hero whose Role is hard
to assume for the opponents, you should already know what will be your
Heroic Ability during the draft
and communicate with your teammates before picking Varian so that they can
cover the missing Roles in your team composition.
If you are playing in a Game Mode without draft, however, take a look
at your team composition while the game is loading and decide what is
the best Heroic Ability to choose. While doing so, remember that the
tools offered by a Tank are key elements
to have a successful team composition.

abilities.title: Varian's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
When playing Taunt Build, remember that Taunt can be used to interrupt enemy channels (for example to stop Carrion Swarm by Mal'Ganis).
When going for Colossus Smash Build, always make sure to use Colossus Smash first and other Abilities after in order to increase all damage dealt thanks to the Armor reduction on the enemy Hero.
When choosing Twin Blades, do not go too far from your team so that they can focus the same enemy Hero as you and/or help you to survive.
If your team desperately needs a Tank, do not insist on taking Colossus Smash or Twin Blades of Fury at Level 4 because a Tank is really important to have in team.

abilities.title: Lion's Fang
abilities.text:
Lion's Fang
(Q)
Varian
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Create a shockwave that travels in a straight line, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Each enemy hit heals Varian for 35 (+4% per level), increased to 140 (+4% per level) against Heroes.
Lion's Fang provides decent
waveclear and self-sustain,
furthermore it deals a good amount of damage to enemy Heroes
and Slow them as well. Slowing an enemy Hero from the distance
will help you have them within Charge range. As a result,
this Ability should be used to quickly damage Minion waves in order to relieve lane pressure,
to keep Varian healthy during a team fight, to engage thanks
to the Slow provided, or to secure a kill thanks to the damage it deals. When you
want to heal as much as possible, remember that the healing provided is about
3 times higher when it is being used on enemy Heroes, therefore you should
prefer hitting a single Hero instead of 3 non-Heroes.

abilities.title: Parry
abilities.text:
Parry
(W)
Varian
Mana: 30
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 10 seconds
Parry all incoming Basic Attacks for 1.25 seconds, reducing their damage by 100%.
Stores up to 2 charges.
Parry
completely prevents all damage from Basic Attacks that would hit
Varian for the duration. It has 2 charges that can be
used in quick succession or in different moments. Remember that hits
coming from Structures (including the Core) and Summons (for example the Hydralisk
created by Zagara using Hunter Killer) are considered
Basic Attacks as well.

abilities.title: Charge
abilities.text:
Charge
(E)
Varian
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Charge to the target enemy, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing them by 75% for 1 second.
Charge provides Varian with a much-needed
gap-closer that can be used both
offensively and defensively. If used offensively, Varian can damage and
Slow his chosen target to either take them down by himself
or allow his teammates
to follow up. If used defensively, Varian can escape dangerous situations
by charging an enemy target who is far from the main action.
This type of Ability does not allow the Hero
to pass through impassable terrain and Structures, instead
the Hero will try to go around that obstacle. Since there is a maximum distance
that can be travelled, the Hero will eventually stop the animation without
reaching the target.

abilities.title: Taunt
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Taunt
(R)
Varian
Heroic
Mana: 20
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.
Taunt turns Varian into a
Tank by increasing his maximum Health and giving him
crowd control for
engaging and/or peeling.
As a side note, it can also be used to play Varian
as Offlaner.

abilities.title: Colossus Smash
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Colossus Smash
(R)
Varian
Heroic
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.
Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.
Colossus Smash turns Varian into a
Melee Assassin by highly increasing
his damage output and providing him another
gap-closer next to Charge.
By picking this Heroic Ability, he becomes capable of dealing
a large amount of damage within a short period of time to take down his target
as quickly as possible while also increasing the damage output of his
teammates at the same time thanks to the Armor reduction.
When you want to unleash all your power on the enemy,
it is advised to use it as the very first Ability to maximize the value you get
from the Armor being reduced for a few seconds.
Despite it being a Heroic Ability, it can be used for non-Heroic targets
(for example to help your team taking down a Boss
a bit faster than usual) thanks to its relatively short cooldown.

abilities.title: Twin Blades of Fury
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Twin Blades of Fury
(R)
Varian
Passive
Heroic
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.
Twin Blades of Fury turns Varian into a
Bruiser who can deal a lot of sustain damage if he can
stick on the target, and the Movement Speed provided slightly helps with that.
The one-dimensional design of this Heroic Ability makes Varian stronger in duels
that happen while playing as Offlaner and weaker
in team fights where many enemy Heroes can peel him away
from his target. The damage reduction on Basic Attacks is compensated by the
cooldown reduction on Heroic Strike.

abilities.title: Heroic Strike
abilities.text:
Heroic Strike
(D)
Varian
Cooldown: 18 seconds
Every 18 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack deals 125 (+4% per level) bonus Spell Damage. Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.
Heroic Strike increases the damage done by Varian's
Basic Attacks by adding a Spell Damage component to them.
The cooldown reduction basically helps you get the second activation
earlier than usual. Try to start a team fight when Heroic Strike is ready,
otherwise your damage output will not be the best.

Cooldown: 20 seconds
Smash a target enemy, dealing 185 (+4% per level) damage and lowering their Armor by 25 for 3 seconds, causing them to take 25% increased damage.
Passive: Base Attack Damage increased by 100%.
Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration reduced by 10%.
Colossus Smash is a good Heroic Ability that turns Varian into a highly explosive
Melee Assassin, but it reduces his maximum Health.
Choose this Heroic Ability when a second Assassin is needed.
The Armor reduction effect provided will drastically
increase your team's damage output when correctly focusing
the damage on the same target.
?
Twin Blades of Fury
(Level 4)
Varian
Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.
Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%.
Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.
Twin Blades of Fury is a decent Heroic Ability
that turns Varian into a Bruiser.
Choose this Heroic Ability when an Offlaner is needed.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Varian
talent_pages.text:
?
Lionheart
(Level 7)
Varian
Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.
Lionheart is a good Talent
which enhances Varian's self-healing if Lion's Fang hits enemy Heroes,
without the need of getting personal as it can be done from the distance.
Being based on a skillshot
with the possibility to hit multiple Heroes for extra value,
this Talent works better against team compositions that feature
multiple melee and/or low-mobility Heroes,
since they are usually easier to hit.
?
Second Wind
(Level 7)
Varian
Basic Attacks heal Varian for 1% of his maximum Health. While below 50% Health, they also heal him for 50% of the damage dealt.
Second Wind is a good Talent that
unconditionally increases Varian's self-healing, especially
if there are no Blinds or crowd control
to prevent him from landing Basic Attacks.
Second Wind is obviously good when paired with Colossus Smash
or Twin Blades of Fury. Due to the fact that Second Wind's second effect
scales with Varian's maximum Health, it becomes quite strong if paired with Taunt too.
✔
Victory Rush
(Level 7)
Varian
Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 (+4% per level) Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
Victory Rush is a strong Talent that gives a burst of healing
when you Basic Attack any target, however, it only works once every 30 seconds
and its cooldown can be reduced by staying near dying Minions and Monsters.
While this Talent does not go off when you have full Health,
its main downside is that it can end up overhealing you if you are almost full Health when it goes off.
Considering that
it triggers more often if you have enemy Minions or Monsters nearby,
this Talent is way better on Maps where team fights happen near them
(such as Braxis Holdout, Dragon Shire, or
Infernal Shrines).

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Varian
talent_pages.text:
?
Shield Wall
(Level 10)
Varian
Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.
Shield Wall is a good Talent that can make you Invulnerable,
but this advantage comes at the cost of a Charge of Overpower.
As a consequence, this Talent is not that good against Heroes who rely on Basic Attacks.
Pick this Talent when playing against burst damage and you
are scared of dying from it.
✔
Warbringer
(Level 10)
Varian
Reduce Charge's cooldown by 8 seconds and Mana cost from 45 to 25. Additionally, Charge can be cast on allied Heroes.
Warbringer is a strong Talent that lowers the cooldown on
Charge by 8 seconds, a nice boost to both his
chasing and peeling capabilities.
In addition to that, you will also be able to use Charge on allied Heroes
as a form of escape or just to reposition yourself during team fights.
The cooldown reduction provided by this Talent has good synergy
with Juggernaut at Level 13,
allowing you to deal more damage in prolonged team fights.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Varian
talent_pages.text:
?
Juggernaut
(Level 13)
Varian
Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.
Juggernaut is a good choice when your team wants to
focus the enemy front line first and/or if the enemy team has several Heroes
with high maximum Health (such as Stitches, Chen,
and Azmodan). In case of prolonged team fights, this Talent
has good synergy with Warbringer at Level 10.
✔
Mortal Strike
(Level 13)
Varian
Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.
Mortal Strike is a strong Talent that
reduces the healing received by enemy Heroes recently hit
with Heroic Strike,
which automatically goes off when you Basic Attack.
Make sure it's not on cooldown when you need it.
We recommend this Talent against team compositions featuring 2 Healers
or when you want to counter some Heroes with self-healing capabilities (such as Arthas),
but not against solo Healers with limited healing (notably Lúcio).
If you decided to go for a Taunt Build featuring Taunt
at Level 4 and Overpower at Level 1, you can guarantee an
application of Mortal Strike after successfully Taunting an
enemy Hero and Parrying the following Basic Attack even if
Heroic Strike is on cooldown when you
engage.
?
Shattering Throw
(Level 13)
Varian
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Activate to throw a sword at a target Hero that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage, and up to 1400 (+4% per level) bonus damage to their Shields.
Passive: Basic Attacks against Heroes deal up to 200% bonus Physical Damage to Shields.
Shattering Throw is a very powerful but situational
Talent that can be used to hard counter Shields (for example it can be used to
completely deny Sound Barrier by Lúcio on the
target that you and your team intend to focus).

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Varian
talent_pages.text:
?
Banner of Stormwind
(Level 16)
Varian
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.
Banner of Stormwind is a situational Talent that
can be used to give your whole team Movement Speed in a given area,
allowing Varian and allied Heroes to reposition, chase, or escape.
The short cooldown allows you to use it with more freedom,
especially when combined with Glory to the Alliance at Level 20.
?
Banner of Ironforge
(Level 16)
Varian
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.
Banner of Ironforge is a situational Talent that
provides Armor to Varian and nearby allied Heroes,
decreasing the amount of damage they take from all sources.
Due to its long cooldown compared to the alternatives, only pick it when the enemy team
is capable of one-shotting an allied Hero with huge burst damage
and your team composition does not have the tools to handle that.
✔
Banner of Dalaran
(Level 16)
Varian
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Activate to place a Banner that grants 20% increased Spell Power to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.
Banner of Dalaran is a strong Talent that
increases the damage and healing done by allied Heroes nearby,
useful for either quick team fights or drawn-out battles.
The short cooldown allows you to use it with more freedom,
especially when combined with Glory to the Alliance at Level 20.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Varian
talent_pages.text:
?
Vigilance
(Level 20)
Varian
Being hit by a Hero Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Taunt by 1 second.
Vigilance is a situational Talent that works
only when facing Heroes with high Attack Speed (such as Tychus)
because it allows you to use cast your Heroic Ability twice in quick succession
and snowball the team fight from there.
?
Master at Arms
(Level 20)
Varian
Colossus Smash affects all enemies near the target, and its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
Master at Arms is a decent Talent to reduce
the Armor of multiple enemy Heroes at the same time
and reduces Colossus Smash's cooldown.
Extending the Armor reduction effect to enemy Heroes
near your main target is great when your team features Heroes
capable of dealing high area of effect damage.
The cooldown reduction may be useful when your first attempt to
burst down an enemy Hero does not go as planned.
?
Frenzy
(Level 20)
Varian
Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.
Frenzy is a decent Talent to increase your own
damage, and it also increases your Movement Speed by a small amount.
✔
Glory to the Alliance
(Level 20)
Varian
Banner now also increases health regeneration and all healing received for nearby allied Heroes by 50%, and the cooldown is reduced by 50%.
Glory to the Alliance is a strong Talent because it
provides both increased healing to the whole team and cooldown reduction on any
Level 16 Talent.
Together with the healing reduction from Mortal Strike at Level 13,
the extra healing provided by this Talent makes Varian great against
team compositions featuring 2 Healers.
If paired with Banner of Dalaran
or Banner of Stormwind that have only
25 seconds of cooldown, you can basically spam it every 12 seconds, even if
just for checking a bush after another—a trap by the enemy team in the
late game can have a devastating outcome.
?
Demoralizing Shout
(Level 20)
Varian
Cooldown: 20 seconds
Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.
Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.
Demoralizing Shout is a situational Talent that
can be activated to reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes within 5.5 range.
Furthermore, whenever allied Heroes take damage from enemy Heroes affected
by Demoralizing Shout, its cooldown
and Parry's cooldown will be slightly reduced.
This kind of effect works best against Heroes who deal
burst damage from a relatively short distance.
Being able to debuff enemy Heroes
allows Varian to protect not only himself
but also nearby allied Heroes who might be in danger.
While it is ideal to hit multiple Heroes with it, do not hesitate to use
Demoralizing Shout on a single Hero when needed.
